data.name: Vigilance
data.description: You gain low-light vision. In addition, as a full-round action %1/day, you can see through up to 5 ft. of stone, wood, or similar barriers as if they didn't exist. Metal or denser barriers block this effect. Each use of this ability lasts as long as you concentrate, up to %2 rounds.|HKDiscipline|HellknightLvl
